reviews.title: Not the best option for night shift workers
reviews.text:
I paid for this app because it promises to help with intermittent fasting, calorie tracking, and hydration. Unfortunately, it works very poorly for people who work night shifts.

My main issue is that the app resets everything at midnight instead of tracking calories and progress throughout the actual fasting/eating cycle. I follow a 16:8 schedule, and because I work nights, my eating window often continues well past midnight. Even though I’m still in the same eating window, the app starts a new day, asks me to begin a new fast, and expects me to log food separately.

As a result, I have to manually calculate how many calories I ate before and after midnight just to know whether I’m staying within my calorie target. Instead of making fasting easier, the app creates unnecessary confusion and extra work. I constantly have to go back through my logs and recalculate information that the app should be handling automatically.

Many other intermittent fasting apps track calories and progress from the end of one fast to the beginning of the next, regardless of whether midnight passes in between. That approach makes far more sense, especially for shift workers and anyone with a non-traditional schedule.

Please consider adding a night-shift mode or allowing calorie tracking to follow fasting cycles rather than calendar days. Until then, I cannot recommend this app to people who work overnight shifts.

reviews.title: Great potential, but not there yet
reviews.text: Have been using the app for a few months now - the premium version at a fee. The interface is nice and the kcals tracking is easier than fully manual tools, however there are some elements I’d expect an AI powered tracker to be better at. For example, portion sizes (grams) are chronically miscalculated, even when the picture shows the packaging with grams (and kcals!) displayed on it. The app also doesn’t seem to learn from my corrections, as it keeps misidentifying the same foods leaving me to manually correct it every day I eat it. I also would like the ‘re-log what you’ve eaten before’ option to work better, as I can only re-log meals I’ve eaten in the last few days, rather than select from all of the meals I’ve eaten in the past. Hopefully this improves before my annual subscription renews, it will determine whether I’ll keep the app.

It does not tell you what you need to eat like every day and everything like how people are saying that all I was told the raccoon helped me lose weight and then the raccoon doesn’t do what people are saying it does. It’s not even a good tracking app. I can’t put everything I want in at one time unless I take a picture with sometimes I don’t wanna do. I feel silly trying to take a picture and it’s not that accurate. It will tell you one thing and do another. It’s weird like any other thing I can scan like I scanned and I put the whole box and they’re not as one serving and it shows you the box and the serving it’s not ready yet and if this looks crazy, I’m doing talk to text that was bad I know

reviews.title: Doesn’t work properly
reviews.text: I had this app for a week and was tricked into paying for a yearly subscription disguised as a monthly subscription, but it didn’t bother me too much as the app seemed decent. Now a week later I can’t log anything, it keeps telling me I have no connection, I can’t log water intake, food, or start my fasting on the app at all. Seems like the whole thing has shut down. Been like it for 2 days now, even after I updated the app thinking it’s fix the issue. Trying to get a refund since I clearly wasted my money.

reviews.title: Cute but pointless
reviews.text:
It’s such a cute idea but it’s so inaccurate and a bit pointless. It says you eat to feed your raccoon but nothing really happens when you don’t eat except some annoying notifications encouraging you to eat more (not what I want to do). It would be nice if your food choices (good or bad) affected the raccoon and made it happy, sad, sick, etc. the AI is also really weird because it will tell off for having bacon because it’s high in processed fat at the top section and then commend me for choosing bacon for protein in the bottom section. 
I really wish I hadn’t paid for this app and could have my money back!

reviews.title: Con artists - will take money after you have cancelled
reviews.text:
I feel all the positive reviews of this app must be fake. The food logging facility is really inaccurate, which means actually trying to log your calories is a game of chance. It is a shame as the idea is good. There are so many better apps out there which allow you to track calories better. I don’t normally leave reviews but this app was so bad I felt I should to warn people.
Update - also takes money after you have cancelled!!!

reviews.title: It’s cute but inefficient
reviews.text: Really disappointed in how this works. The raccoon and the “aesthetics” is really cute and all. But it doesn’t give true calorie or nutrition information unless you have the nutritional value like on the back of the package. They advertise just snap a pic a go but even when you order say a cob salad from chick fil a, it doesn’t pull that nutritional information. Just a generic salad. It sometimes recognizes all the ingredients and most of the time it doesn’t. If you get a smoothie from somewhere, better know the information yourself, it just plugs it in as a generic smoothie. It’s not actually using ai to search for the ingredients or search the web for nutritional values. You have to go look for it yourself, which is fine, and track it that way. But at that point what am I paying for? Better off buying a notebook. I paid for a year and used it for 2 weeks. What a waste.

reviews.title: Zero Stars
reviews.text: I saw this app on Instagram and had to buy a subscription just to see what the app did, and when I found out that the app would not work for my dietary plan/journey, I contacted their customer support to ask for a refund. Whoever “Jake from BitePal” needs a lesson in customer service. First of all, you send me an offer to stay on your app and give me a 30% refund, then when I ask for a full refund, it’s like I asked for your first born child and all of a sudden, I’m the bad guy. He fights me for $15. Like, it’s only $15. And when we keep emailing back and forth, he ends up ghosting me and leaving me on read. So a week later, I email him again to follow up and he reminds me that a full refund is not possible unless I use the app for a certain period of time (which is dumb if I can’t even use the app), and he asks me to send him proof that I’ve used the app for the allotted time. Instead, I send him a screenshot of the email he sent me the first time offering me a refund and an apology. When he sees it, he finally offers me the 30% (only) refund in a very brash email. I’ve seen a lot of rude customer service in my day, but this felt excessive. I can’t even use your app, why are you trying to fight me on giving me back my $15. It’s not the end of the world, Jake. It’s $15. Now, all my friends know about this and will not use your app either.

reviews.title: In accurate calories and charges extra randomly
reviews.text: If I could give zero stars I would. I don’t know how to explain how completely disappointed I am in this app. If you scan a label half the time it’s inaccurate on the calories amount and the protein amount. Anytime I go through fast food I have to correct it against the restaurants own health guides that they put out. So completely in accurate. To top all of this off they didn’t allow me access to the app while I was paying for the weekly subscription. So I upgraded to the yearly subscription. Then they started charging me for a higher weekly subscription price at the same time. And charged me randomly like multiple days in a row instead of it actually being weekly. Then when I canceled they canceled my yearly and didn’t cancel my weekly. Furthermore there is not an option to cancel the weekly but I was able to find that for the yearly. I’m so unimpressed it is sad. However they refuse to make it right and I have to go the long way to get my money back that was stolen from me.

reviews.title: Entertaining, but don’t trust them
reviews.text:
I signed up for 12 weeks but got bored very quickly with this app. It might work well for others but not for me. 
What I really dislike is that there was no way to cancel, I could not see subscription settings in my account, or through the App Store. Never received any emails. So I assumed it was just payment for 12 weeks and the app would prompt for further payment. They just tried to take another 12 weeks payment out of my account with no prior warning. It’s just really shady.

reviews.title: Siguen cobrando tras cancelar
reviews.text: Realicé la cancelación de la suscripción y aun así siguen realizando cobros sin autorización.

reviews.title: Estafa
reviews.text: No recomiendo la app, no puedo cancelar la suscripción

reviews.title: Useless
reviews.text:
The first constructive feedback I have to give is that the developers need to offer a free trial for pro. Although I suspect they know if they did, they wouldn’t get any monetary sign ups. 

Secondly, I tried the AI photo recognition on a dish which I knew the nutritional content for and it was about 300% higher in its estimation, the macros were all over the place. Meh I thought, it’ll probably be off a little. Later I tried the ‘text add’ option instead. How is the data for something so common as “Huel black” all wrong?! The kcal and the macros all needed adjusting. I wanted to give the app a chance so day 2 I opened the app to add my daily weigh in. What’s this? Everything is blank? No goals, no data, the only thing that carried over was the useless raccoon things name. After setting up the app again, still nothing showed. Removed app and reinstalled, signed in, still nothing. Set up goal again and it still didn’t register or show anything (as in the main page is blank, no weight, telling me to enter my goal etc).  I figured at that point I gave it more time than it warranted and canceled my one week subscription. Back to MFP it is. Useless app don’t bother.

reviews.title: Pretty sure this is a scam
reviews.text:
The app itself has very limited functionality even with the paid plan, and the AI nutrition calculation is wildly inaccurate. I have not found it to be particularly helpful for tracking calories and macros and the UI is less accessible than most other apps which do the same job.

There is seemingly no option to cancel your subscription from within the app, and the recurring payment does not appear in the app store either. The only way to stop them taking payment is to email, but no one seems to reply.

tl;dr: try the free version is you want but DO NOT give them payment details.

reviews.title: Don’t subscribe.
reviews.text:
I paid for the trial version of this app, but didn’t feel it right for me as it had the same features as other apps that are a lot cheaper, with more features.
There is no way to cancel in the app and they persistently tried to take the money from my account. 
I emailed support and spoke to someone called Jake, who told me he had cancelled it manually, only to then have an attempted charge again this morning from a different source ‘Reface Lithuania UAB’. Same amount and using the BitePal logo within the ‘payment unsuccessful email’.

reviews.title: Cute at first but a nightmare to cancel
reviews.text: I downloaded this app as a fun way of tracking my food but to be honest half the time it didn't calculate the correct calories for the food I was eating as I would check and compare to the packaging even when weighing out my food etc. I decided after a week it wasn't for me and i contacted bitepal to cancel my subscription. I received an email from someone called Jake who assured me my account would be cancelled and no further payments taken. The next day I had a notification from my bank to say a payment had tried to be taken but luckily I didn't have enough in my account to cover it. I sent another email to bitepal and again received another email back from Jake who again assured me my account had been cancelled and no further payment would be taken. I have since had 3 payments tried to be taken from my account and I have sent numerous emails with no response from "Jake" or anyone else. Avoid this app at all costs if you are looking to trial it first, it's not that great anyway and there are much better apps out there to track your calories

reviews.title: Super inaccurate & super time consuming
reviews.text:
I have been using the paid version of this app for 51 days now & I can say it’s one of the worst nutrient apps I’ve ever used. The idea of it is cute, & that’s the only nice thing I can say. 

It’s super time consuming. If you want ALMOST accurate nutrient facts you have to take a picture of the label, but you will still have to manually update some of the nutrients. You can snap a picture of your meal, but it will never guess what you’re eating & worse, it doesn’t give you a drop down menu of what it could be. I have my preferences set to vegan, if I take a picture of the vegan burger itself it thinks it’s a real burger, & there’s no option to change what it is. 
Also when you do take a picture of the meal & not the nutrient facts it’s never even been close to accurate!! & it won’t let you manually adjust the macros when snapping a picture of the meal, so you’re forced to do the nutrient labels. Which also means when you go out to eat you’ll never have any idea of what your macros could be. 

You also can’t save any meals!!! This by far is the worst part. So every day when I make my same 5 ingredient breakfast I have to take a picture of 5 nutrient labels… yes you can select items you had from the day before, but it only saves about 4 things from the day before, so by the time I’m making my breakfast I can only see my dinner options to select again. 

So yes, feeding a raccoon is a super cute idea, but unless the app changes its accuracy & how it saves meals, it will never b

reviews.title: Do not trust
reviews.text: This is my first ever review, simply to warn you all to stay away from this app. I wish I had read all the other awful reviews before signing up and giving them personal information. It’s a terrible app, doesn’t work and they do not respond to any emails. Refused refund as I hadn’t used it for a month, however it didn’t work, so unusable. No correspondence after 3 emails, and can’t find where to cancel subscription. Much better apps to use other than this one - not sure the other reviews are genuine.

reviews.title: Wanted to love it. Glitches made it unusable.
reviews.text:
I downloaded Bitepal after seeing it on TikTok. I’m on a GLP-1 and really just need something simple to track calories, protein, and fiber. I don’t need all the extra features that apps like MyFitnessPal have. During the 3-day trial, Bitepal felt perfect. Simple, cute, and exactly what I was looking for. I even recommended it to friends. 

Unfortunately, as soon as I paid the $30 annual membership, the app started glitching.

When I log food, it disappears as if I never entered it. 

I still get prompted to “level up to premium” even though I already paid. 

The calorie and macro accuracy is also way off. The app promotes snapping a photo of your plate or packaging to track food, but unless you photograph the actual nutrition label, the numbers are incorrect.

Another big downside: you can’t save meals. If I make a smoothie or overnight oats and want to track it again, I have to manually re-enter every single ingredient each time.

I also get notifications that my raccoon is waiting for me to log food  even after I’ve logged multiple times  and when I open the app, the entries are gone.

I really wanted to love this app because the concept and design are great. But between the glitches, inaccurate tracking, and missing basic features, it’s not reliable enough to use especially when you’re paying for it.

reviews.title: Customer service ghosted me
reviews.text:
Beware that this app still has a lot of growing and improving to do. It has a lot of limitations still such as if you forget to set the time or type of meal when you are entering a food, there’s no way to correct it. You can’t build a recipe, its information is very inaccurate, etc. I made the mistake of going in for 3 months for the savings and when I requested a refund after a few days I was only offered more months at no cost. When I declined and stated I wanted a refund only they never responded. I’ve sent follow up emails with no response. Don’t make the same mistake, do a trial first. The price will be higher if you like it and want to keep it but it’s a waste of money for me!

Follow up…Day 28 from purchase and day 24 from their last communication to me despite me reaching out 2 more times since then. Now they “remind” me that I have to cancel with 30 days (DID) AND have used it for 15 consecutive days. I stopped using it immediately after requesting a refund because I didn’t want them to claim I continued to use it despite my issues with it not accurately working. And conveniently they don’t follow up until is well outside of the window of opportunity to do that. DO NOT FALL FOR THEIR MARKETING, DO NOT PURCHASE MORE THAN THE SHORTEST PLAN UNTIL YOU KNOW IF THE APP DOES WHAT YOU NEED. I’ve learned my lesson, hopefully you are not suckered in too. Don’t assume that the high rating actually means it’s a helpful app.

reviews.title: Definite room for improvement
reviews.text: I really wanted to like this app. It seemed great. Scan my food. I don’t have to look for calories anymore. No barcode scanning. But it was too good to be true. I found that the calories that the AI attributed to food is more often wrong than not. You cannot change the category of something you have eaten or drink after the fact. Copying things from one day to another is clunky. On more than one occasion, I have had the app glitch and not show food I’ve added, which has made me go back and add it again, which in the end doubles the item because it did go in the first time only it didn’t register appside. The raccoon is cute and the coins are a good motivator, but it doesn’t take away from the faults of this app. I think with time, and a lot of work, this app could be much better. However, for the time being, I’m going back to the calorie tracking app that I’ve always used and that is just better functioning. I regret spending money on this.

reviews.title: Do not spend money on this
reviews.text: This is a very useless app for people who are serious about loosing weight. The data is incorrect every time you scan an image. And there’s no way to make meals or find a better option for what you’re trying to track like my fitness pal has. This is NOT something you’d want to use if you’re serious about tracking macros or calories. And the only “plan” you get is your macro calculations which are also very incorrect for mine when I sit with a legitimate coach. I had to import them myself. And it’s nothing like keeping a tamagotchi alive. So basically nothing that this app advertises is what it is. If you’re not serious about loosing weight and just want the accountability of tracking food but not worried about the calories this would be good for you. It gives insightful info about the quality of your food such as vitamins and nutrients which is cool.

reviews.title: Crashes almost every day
reviews.text:
This app is so flaky. About every other day it won’t open at all. I have to close it or restart the phone several times before it will work. Some days I can only track half my food or less do it’s useless. The recent update made it marginally better for a week or so and now it’s crashing again all the time. Do not waste your money signing up for anything as they still then want more money to buy further upgrades. I paid for 12 weeks and still only have the very basic access. Their help line email bounces back so you can’t report any issues.
The AI isn’t even that good either when it scans food and usually gets the mass completely wrong. The raccoon is cute but never offers me any advice like it promised to do as that’s even more in app purchases. I’ve been trying use it for a month now and it’s driven me crazy with all the restarts just to try to maintain a streak.
If I could get my money back I would but the emails bounce back! Don’t waste your money.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text:
Upon downloading this app I payed £15, I tried the app and used it consecutively for a few days, but it wasn’t for me and I stopped using it. The ai is poor and the calorie calculations are wrong, I had to edit and put them in myself, which defeats the main purpose of the app in my opinion. 
Because I had stopped using this app I worried I had applied for a long subscription, so I searched everywhere for a way to cancel it. There is no way to on the app or the App Store because it is a separate organisation. To this I presumed I didn’t have a subscription because did not tell me otherwise, (I didn’t remember paying for an atrociously priced subscription) then I woke up this morning with £40 out of my account. I have emailed requesting a refund. Don’t get the app it’s confusing and not fit for purpose.

reviews.title: DO NOT BUY
reviews.text: Not sure how this app has so many good reviews. Signed up for the free trial advertised as 3 days and notification on the 2nd day to say it ends in 24 hours. On the 2nd day I had the yearly subscription fee leave my bank. They provide one email to contact, which after looking online no one can get an answer from. Myself and others have cancelled the subscription through Apple and request a refund but then the app uses your bank details directly and takes more and more money, double charges etc without going through Apple. This app is nothing but a scam!!!! Buyers beware

reviews.title: Horrible y te cobran plata que no corresponde
reviews.text: Esta aplicación es una basura total, funciona pesimo, NO SIRVE. Hice la prueba pagando el 50% del precio osea 9 uds, la utilice una semana y la odie completamente, elimine la cuenta y este mes me cargaron 18 dolares en mi tarjeta y el mes siguiente tambien lo haran. 18 dolares de una cuenta ELIMINADA QUE NO USE

reviews.title: Estafa
reviews.text: Te suscribe sin permiso usando los datos de tu tarjeta y no se pueda dar de baja

reviews.title: Estafa
reviews.text: Cancele la suscripción a penas la levanté y me cobraron igual

reviews.title: Avoid at all costs!
reviews.text: Not intelligent in the slightest! Just as an example, it gave me the reference for an entire package when trying to break it down by portions. I was mis-sold some kind of upgrade that I never opted in for, when contacting customer service, took them nearly 3 weeks to get back to me, only to completely ignored my request for a refund and also to cancel my subscription. The subscription does not show under the normal tab in the App Store, I have seen a huge amount of people having the same issue. I made the mistake to just get the app before doing my research, regret doesn’t start to cover it all. Absolutely terrible. If you are calorie counting, you are much better off using Lose It or My Fitness Pal, great reliable apps with much better functions. Oh, and they actually work.

reviews.title: SCAM - DO NOT PURCHASE SUBSCRIPTION
reviews.text: I tried this out for 2/3 days as I was trying different methods to eat healthier and I didnt like the app based way as much as I thought I would and so I asked to cancel my subscription with a refund and they emailed me saying first they would send me 30% back and then they didn’t send me any money back at ALL! I have email screenshots. Don’t buy from a company that will faithfully return your money if you’re not happy with the product. They’re a scam  and I believe they’re running this business from Dubai! I will write these reviews on tiktok and all social media platforms and report them. The app said it was £5 so I tried it but they took £27 something out of my account and the AI calorie tracker is so inaccurate. They just want money and the workers are a scam. I have never experienced this from an app before. Scary people out there and so sad

reviews.title: Not great to use
reviews.text: Logging meals is too difficult. The AI picture thing is very inaccurate, getting the meal and the portion sizes very wrong. Inputting the food manually is also exhausting, especially when you’ve got multiple ingredients in a dish that’s partly for your dinner, a bigger portion for your parter, with leftovers for their lunch the next day - there’s no way to easily divide this up without you having to do all the maths. MyFitnessPal is a lot easier. Also not sure how I feel about a raccoon calling me pookie?

reviews.title: Terrible! Impossible to cancel subscription
reviews.text: I’ve tried to cancel my subscription. I’ve emailed weeks ago and had no response. I’ve deleted my account completely so when I enter my email address to log in it says I don’t have an account. They still tried to take money for subscription so I’ve had to cancel my card so they can’t take the money. Depsite emailing and no longer having an account, I keep getting emails saying payment has failed and if I hadn’t cancelled my card they would’ve fraudulently taken a lot of money!!!! AVOID

reviews.title: It’s just a glorified stopwatch
reviews.text:
I use this app religiously for two weeks. If you do not turn on and off the fasting button yourself it just keeps counting without notifying you that your time is up or anything. There is no setting for fast from 6 AM to 8 PM. It’s only time increments so if you miss your window to turn it off, you screw up your window for the next time.

The best thing that this app had going for it is the AI food recognition. Just snap a picture and it will tell you what you’re having how many calories carbs, fat, protein and fiber and it will take a picture and tell you what you’re having with more or less good accuracy. However, it is very poor at recognizing the amount of food it is seeing so the portions are almost always incorrect. So you end up putting in the correct nutrition points manually which defeats the whole purpose of the AI technology.

You can replace this entire app with ChatGPT and the stopwatch on your phone. So it really comes down to do you wanna pay a subscription fee to try to get a raccoon new little clothes and a new setting to sit in. I paid $20 to have this app for three months and I still feel like I was overcharged.

reviews.title: Zero Stars! Broken App and Scam!
reviews.text:
The app is broken and bugged. I couldn’t use any of its features like scanning labels or take meal photos. It would constantly give me errors. Even if I tried to type what I had their supposed “AI” would never work or understand what I entered.

I requested a refund and they only offered 30% which is shocking. If you bought anything and it was faulty and requested a refund you’d be honoured with a full refund but not this company…sold me a broken app and didn’t give me the courtesy of a full refund…

I’d give this Zero stars if I could! Do not buy this app!!!!

reviews.title: Cute idea but wildly inaccurate
reviews.text: The Ai system is very inaccurate, often calculating calories way over what is actually on the plate, its pointless to have that feature if we then need to back up the calories by calculating it ourselves. The way you enter your meals just isnt helpful, I could upload a cheesestring and it registers that its a meal. Theres not way of categorising different meals, snacks etc Im just finding it very unhelpful and turning to other apps to track more efficiently

reviews.title: Not fit for purpose
reviews.text:
After one week of use (paid subscription) I can honestly advise people not to bother with it. Calorie counting is very unreliable and inaccurate, you will spend a lot of time editing the values generated by the AI. 
Meal plans aren’t very customisable and are very repetitive often eating the same dish multiple times a week. I used the restrictions and allergies setting to ensure certain foods were omitted yet they still appeared in my meal plan. I assume there’s only a small selection of meals in the entire menu. 
Fasting has to be activated and deactivated manually each day despite entering your fasting schedule into the settings. This should be automated with an option to edit individual days if needed. The amount of times I forgot to start and stop fasting or didn’t do it on time and then had to edit it once the fast had completed was ridiculous.  

Won’t be renewing the subscription.

reviews.title: Avoid
reviews.text:
Just use MyFitnessPal, it’s just a better app. 

Bitepal’s AI calculator doesn’t work. I scan the same items for different days and the calorie count is different every time. 

Account management is extremely poor. There is no way to manage or cancel subscriptions, so if you applied for free 7 day trial and wanted to cancel? You simply can’t, not on your own through the app. No subscription management in the settings, and they have no website. The only settings are “change password”, “delete account” or change basic personal details. I emailed them twice, however, support did not respond to my email after 10 days. They make the process of cancelling/amending subscription difficult and unclear on purpose so that they could keep charging your card freely and you can’t do much about it.

Would not recommend at all due to lack of basic account controls and poor service.

reviews.title: Do not buy
reviews.text: I wanted to try this app so I signed up for the normal plan which was around £5 which I could afford however it then advertised to me the premium plan so I clicked on the link to see more information about it but it automatically signed me up and took nearly £20 out of my account. I contacted the support email however it provided me with a generated response cancelling my subscription but not mentioning any refund which is not what i asked for. Do not buy this app as signing up is confusing a you may end up spending more money than expected without realising.

reviews.title: Awful customer service; deliberately confusing terms of service meant to trap you
reviews.text: My health insurance requires the use of a weight loss management program. I downloaded this app off of the App Store and paid for a 12 on day one. Within 24 hours, I realized that I needed a very specific weight loss program and this would no longer suit my purposes. So within 24 hours, I contacted support and asked for a full refund. According to their terms of service if you purchase the subscription through the App Store, which I did, you need to notify them within two days to get a full refund, which I did. They are saying I did not use the App Store to get the subscription,which is false, and they are absolutely refusing to refund my $28. Now my only recourse is to write a negative review in hopes of discouraging anyone else from download loading and paying for this app. They have terrible customer service and do not honor their terms of service.

reviews.title: Cute concept but unfit for purpose
reviews.text: The AI is extremely inaccurate . Every single calorie amount guess has been SO off. For example my noodles which are stated on the packaging as 525 calories were marked as 1749 calories by the AI. That’s just insane for noodles. Having something be so wrong is actually really harmful to people using this to stay healthy because you’re causing them to eat the wrong amounts because they think they’re already over their calorie count when they’re not. Maybe even the opposite happens too where they’re underestimated and people think they have more space for more food when actually they’re already over their limit. The app is not fit for use until the accuracy is improved. The free features are also a lot more limited than similar apps so I’ll switch back to my previous one. It’s also too encouraging. I can eat something bad and go over my calorie limit and the app is like ‘yayyyy’. How is that helpful?

reviews.title: Not Very Accurate or Helpful
reviews.text: The app is….fine.  I have been using for about a week.  It is super easy to snap a picture of your meals and the app recognizes the food; however, the only measurement tool seems to be in ounces, which is really hard when many foods are measured more easily in grams.  Additionally, you can’t edit the amount of food taken in, which limits you to only logging when you’re done eating.  I have used other apps that allow me to see BEFORE I eat how many calories I am about to intake and if I end up not eating the amount of food I anticipated eating at first I can change the amount of food I ate.   It is not really helpful to edit your calories after the fact.  It would be more beneficial to have the ability to alter weight and amounts.  Additionally, I really wish there was a way to provide amounts eaten in more options than just ounces.  I am not likely to measure condiments in ounces. I am more likely to measure in tablespoons or grams.  Additionally, I am not going to measure my fruits in grams. I’m just going to say how many I had.  Instead of trying to guess my weight in grapes, I would rather say I had 10 grapes.  Additionally, the ads were very misleading.  I was under the impression I would get real feedback on how to improve my nutrition with recommendations from my cute little raccoon, but my raccoon is mostly useless.  It tells me I don’t have enough fiber, but I don’t have recommendations on how to actually take in more fiber. I upped my veggies green but it didn’t impr

reviews.title: SCAM!!!
reviews.text: It said i needed to pay for a discounted subscription and there would be a 7 day free trial. I deleted my account pretty much immediately once I realized they were going to charge $41/mo not the discount they advertised. There was nowhere in the app I could find to cancel subscription so I did not just delete the app, I deleted my actual account and checked my subscriptions on apple and saw none listed. I assumed it was all taken care of and then a week later got charged a subscription for an account that doesn’t exist. The company they use, paddle, would not refund it and forwarded my emails to them and they offered a 30% refund for AN ACCOUNT THAT DOESNT EXIST AND A SUBSCRIPTION I NEVER USED!! I didn’t know it was possible to get scammed like this on the app store because I’ve only ever seen subscriptions through the apple account, I had no idea it could get lost in a third party mess. Do not be fooled and just use My Fitness Pal.

reviews.title: Food tracking not accurate
reviews.text: I’ve unfortunately had to delete this app after using it for a few days due to the AI food tracking being wildly inaccurate. I’ve always wrote very descriptive food logs (eg “homemade burger with wholewheat pita bread and 13 McCains potato wedges”) and the calories calculated would always be off by sometimes hundreds. The AI trips on things very easily - one time I wrote “date filled with peanut butter and covered in dark chocolate” which gave me 240 calories which I knew was WAY off, so I wrote instead this time “ONE date filled with peanut butter covered with dark chocolate” and this time got 130! Definitely needs a bit of work when it comes to intuitive logging and human input, I can’t rely on this app at all to give me an accurate caloric breakdown. I would definitely reconsider downloading it again once this is fixed.
